Where We Build- Our
Global Footprint
Aimtron Electronics, a key part
of the Aimtron Group, operates
two advanced manufacturing
facilities in India. Each site is
designed to handle complex,
high-precision projects with a
strong emphasis on quality and
operational discipline. Our ISO-
certified operations reflect a
deep commitment to excellence,
safety, and environmental
responsibility.
